concerns.text: FR-001 requires a `data/processed/baseline_metrics.json` file, but no completed task in Phase 2 produces this artifact. T011 is marked completed yet its deliverable is only `code/data_loader.py`; T012 (baseline analysis) is still pending, leaving the baseline metric requirement uncovered.

FR-005 mandates `data/processed/cleaned_metrics.json` with results for each cleaning variant. No completed task generates this file; T012 (baseline) and T024 (re‑run analysis on cleaned data) are still pending, so the re‑analysis requirement is unmet.

FR-006 specifies an outlier‑threshold sweep and FPR estimation with a `null_fpr_metrics.json` output. Tasks T033a, T033b, and T039 that would create this output are still pending, meaning the entire FR‑006 deliverable is missing.

SC‑001 requires per‑dataset delta reporting with qualitative directionality. While T027 implements a comparison, there is no explicit task that formats and writes per‑dataset delta reports meeting the precision and directionality wording of the success criterion.

SC‑002 demands all metrics be written with ≥ 3‑decimal precision. Pending tasks (e.g., T012, T069) are the only ones that could enforce this precision; their completion status is unchecked, leaving the precision requirement unverified.

SC‑03 calls for visualizations (forest plot, heatmap) saved under `output/figures/`. Tasks T034 and T035 that generate these figures are still pending, so the visual‑output success criterion is not satisfied.

Tasks T1100‑T1105 introduce new requirements (SC‑006, FR‑007, FR‑008) that do not exist in the current specification. Adding such FR/SC items without an official spec amendment violates Constitution Principle I (no silent constitution drift).

Task T045 enforces a minimum of 1000 bootstrap iterations, but earlier in the plan (not in tasks) a fallback to 500 iterations was described. Ensure no residual fallback logic remains in any script; otherwise it would breach Constitution Principle VI (minimum 1000 iterations, no fallback).
